name: Natural Turf Maintenance
description:
This dataset records natural turf maintenance work performed at parks and public green spaces, organized by borough, district, and site name. Each row represents a work assignment on a given date, with start and end times, crew size, and whether mowing, trimming, and blowing tasks were completed. It also flags whether the crew was able to complete assigned tasks and, when not, the reason (for example, end of day, staffing, equipment, or site in use). The sample covers 5,000 rows across 14 columns, with sites concentrated in Queens, the Bronx, Staten Island, Brooklyn, and Manhattan.

The data can be used to analyze crew productivity and task completion rates, identify sites or districts with frequent incomplete work and the reasons behind it, examine geographic or seasonal patterns in maintenance activity, and support resource planning and service-level reporting for park upkeep.
